about_the_game:
Please be careful when purchasing. This offer does NOT include the Standard Edition of Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. This purchase is only for people that already own the Standard Edition or have a Game Pass subscription that grants them access to the Standard Edition.

 

Upgrade* from Standard Edition to the Premium Deluxe Edition and receive the following additional content: 

 

  • 15 New Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Aircraft

  • 10 Upgraded Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 Aircraft

  • 10 Upgraded Handcrafted Airports

 

* Base Game required (sold separately)

 

This pack includes the following 25 aircraft (15 New for MSFS 2024 and 10 Upgraded from MSFS 2020):

  • Airbus Helicopter H225 (NEW)

  • Amphibian Aerospace Grumman G111 Albatross / Grumman HU-16 Albatross(NEW)

  • Beechcraft Baron G58

  • Beechcraft King Air C90GTx (NEW)

  • Boeing 747-400 Global Supertanker (NEW)

  • Boeing 747-400 LCF Dreamlifter (NEW)

  • Boeing 787-10 Dreamliner

  • Boeing C-17 Globemaster III (NEW)

  • Boeing CH-47 Chinook (NEW)

  • Cessna 152 Aerobat

  • Cessna 172 Skyhawk (SP)

  • Cessna 188 AGTruck (NEW)

  • Cessna 404 Titan (NEW)

  • Cessna 408 SkyCourier (NEW)

  • Cessna Citation Longitude

  • Cirrus SR22

  • Diamond Aircraft DA40 TDi

  • Diamond Aircraft DV20

  • Dornier Seawings Seastar (NEW)

  • Pilatus PC-24 (NEW)

  • Pipistrel Taurus M (NEW)

  • Pipistrel Virus SW 121

  • Saab 340 (NEW)

  • Zlin Aviation Savage Norden (NEW)

  • Zlin Aviation Shock Ultra

 

And the following 10 handcrafted international airports:

  • Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (EHAM)

  • Cairo International Airport (HECA)

  • Cape Town International Airport (FACT)

  • Chicago O'Hare International Airport (KORD)

  • Denver International Airport (KDEN)

  • Dubai International Airport (OMDB)

  • Frankfurt Airport (EDDF)

  • London Heathrow Airport (EGLL)

  • Madrid-Barajas Adolfo Suarez Airport (LEMD)

  • San Francisco International Airport (KSFO)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X or Intel Core i7-6800K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 5700 or GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Network Speed of 10 Mbps Bandwidth
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 2700X or Intel Core i7-10700K
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 5700 XT or GeForce RTX 2080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Network Speed of 50 Mbps Bandwidth
